mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the hearing cells to the fluid-filled chambers was most worthwhile: the result showed how moving fluid bends their hairs and changes signals to nerves.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the eardrums to the canals was straightforward and mostly confirmed what the picture already showed.

surprise.text: I expected the hearing pathways to attach directly to the hearing cells, but the cells needed the inner-ear chambers first.

arbitrary.text: That prerequisite was not obvious to me from the initial pictures, although the result explained the cells' role inside the fluid-filled chambers.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: tracing a familiar sense from moving air to nerve signals was interesting, and I would like to see another process come together.
